notes: Region-composition check inside [data-audit="market-detail"] — MarketSignalDetailSurface mounted with fixture data matching artboard 05's Packaging material input costs example (mounts.mjs MARKET_FIXTURE).

Artboard order top to bottom: header (chips: Signal / severity / topic / band, TIER LAST, header stat, action row) -> exposure grid -> timeline -> sticky section index S1..S6 -> Summary (Generated · 30-second read) -> rail (At a glance, Impact assessment, Relevance, Your notes, In this list, Legend).

children.name: region 1 — header chips include the artboard's Signal/severity/topic/band set
region 2 — action row, exactly Export brief / Share / Watch / + Tag
region 3 — Exposure grid renders before the timeline
region 4 — sticky section index carries all six entries, S1..S6
rail order 1 — AT A GLANCE is the first rail card (artboard 05)
children.note: Fixed once in DetailShell's DetailRail slot order (lane details60, 2026-09-08); the build put IN THIS LIST first on all four detail pages.

children.name: rail order 2 — IMPACT ASSESSMENT is the second rail card (artboard 05)
rail order last — LEGEND is present, after the artboard's own page cards (Your notes, In this list)

forbid.name: no per-item ask bar in the header (ruling 2.3)
forbid.reason: The masthead command bar is the only ask surface.

forbid.name: the place-keeping card is never the first rail card
forbid.reason: Every detail artboard opens its rail with AT A GLANCE; IN THIS LIST comes after it (03/05) or is an R7 undesigned card placed after LEGEND (07/09).
